Setup Guide

Use Signal inside Claude

Ask Claude to underwrite any US address and get the ARV, estimated rent, and comps back in the chat. Setup takes about 3 minutes — no technical know-how required.

⏱ ~3 minutes 🖥 Works on Mac & Windows 🔒 Your data stays yours

  1. Install the Claude desktop app

    Signal connects to the Claude desktop app (not the website). If you don't have it yet, download and install it, then sign in.

    Download Claude Desktop →

  2. Get your Signal API key

    Open Signal and sign in. Click your account menu in the top-right corner and choose API Keys, then click Generate key. Copy the key it shows you — it's only shown once, so keep it somewhere safe.

    Go to Signal →

    MCP access is included on the Investor and Institution plans.

  3. Download the Signal extension

    This is a single file that installs Signal into Claude in one click — no settings to edit.

    Download Signal.mcpb →

  4. Open it & install

    Double-click the Signal.mcpb file you just downloaded. Claude will open and ask if you want to install the Signal Underwriting extension — click Install.

    If double-clicking doesn't open Claude: open Claude, go to Settings → Extensions, click Install Extension…, and choose the file from your Downloads folder.

  5. Paste your API key

    Claude will ask for your Signal API Key. Paste the key from Step 2 into the box and save. That's the only setting.

  6. Ask Claude to underwrite

    Start a new chat in Claude and just ask. For example:

    Underwrite 1112 E Malibu Dr, Tempe, AZ 85282

    Claude will return the ARV, estimated rent, value ranges, and the comps Signal used. A fresh address takes about 20–40 seconds; repeats are instant.

What can I ask? Try things like "What's the ARV and rent on <address>?", "Compare the rent on these three addresses," or "Show me my recent underwritings." Claude uses two Signal tools: underwrite_property and get_history.

Troubleshooting

I don't see Signal in Claude after installing.

Fully quit and reopen the Claude desktop app. Then check Settings → Extensions — "Signal Underwriting" should be listed and enabled.

It says my API key is invalid.

Re-copy the key from your account page (Account → API Keys) and re-enter it in Settings → Extensions → Signal Underwriting. Make sure there are no extra spaces. If you revoked the key, generate a new one.

Can I use this in the Claude website, ChatGPT, or Gemini?

This one-click extension is for the Claude desktop app. You can always use Signal with no setup at all right on our website. ChatGPT support (for paid ChatGPT plans) is coming; the standard Gemini app doesn't support custom tools yet.

Is my API key safe?

Yes. The key is stored by Claude on your own computer and is only used to talk to Signal. It identifies your account and counts against your plan — treat it like a password and don't share it.

How do I remove it?

In Claude, go to Settings → Extensions, find Signal Underwriting, and toggle it off or uninstall it.
